format: Each step: dir (host->device | device->host), endpoint (bulk_out=EP 0x03, bulk_in=EP 0x82, interrupt_in=EP 0x81, 16-byte packets), hex (exact bytes of one USB transfer), annotation. provenance: 'verhue-capture' = hex dump found in Verhue's sources (probably captured from the official editor), 'clavia-derived' = built from the Clavia v1.62 serializers, 'verhue-derived' = built from Verhue's builders, 'synthetic' = device reply invented to match the decoded layout (field values arbitrary but legal).
description: Live parameter, morph and variation messages.

steps.annotation: CMParamChange (realtime) slot A: loc 1 (VA) module 1 param 0 value 64 variation 0. No reply.
CMParamFocusDump (realtime): flag 0, loc VA, module 1, param 0 (select parameter)
CMMorphChange realtime (while dragging): loc VA, module 1, param 0, morph 0, |range| 0x2B, positive, variation 0
CMMorphChange normal (mouse-up) slot C sess 7: FX module 5 param 2 morph 3 range -16 variation 2
CMParamSettingCopy slot A: copy variation 0 -> 8 (Verhue capture 'copy variation 1 -> init')
embedded message -- unsolicited front-panel param change slot B sess 3: VA module 4 param 2 value 127 var 0
embedded message -- unsolicited param focus from panel: slot A, VA module 3 param 5
